confirm.claim_boundary: No Repair disposition may be accepted or promoted to closure until the future Confirm adapter validates issue, patch, source evidence, and regression bindings.

contract_integrity.claim_boundary: Artifact-level contract validity proves trace/accounting integrity only; it authorizes no source semantic element.

final_export.claim_boundary: The future canonical PlantUML exporter will consume semantic roots and collapse compiler members, but this baseline implements and authorizes no final export.

inspect_diagnostics.claim_boundary: Inspect diagnostics are bound as rejected, candidate-only, or insufficient. None is typed source-issue evidence in the baseline contract.

inspect_structure.claim_boundary: Source structure may be inspected; compiler-owned diagnostics are not source issues.

main_result.claim_boundary: Main-result eligibility is owned by the post-loop experiment gate.

parse.claim_boundary: Artifact-level FCSTM parseability only; parse success authorizes no source semantic element or behavioral claim.

repair.claim_boundary: This baseline lists potential source targets but authorizes no edit. Repair eligibility is created only by a separately validated confirmed issue binding.

simulation.claim_boundary: Baseline simulation is not attribution evidence: runtime history lacks stable fired-transition IDs, so a state observation cannot prove that its path avoided compiler macros or unsupported source semantics.

source_static_discovery.claim_boundary: Static Discover may inspect every positively traced source semantic root. Operational debt limits behavioral evidence, not source-text analysis.

transition_trace.claim_boundary: State observations cannot be promoted to transition-level attribution.

verification.claim_boundary: No verification result or counterexample is attribution evidence until a versioned adapter binds the checked property, source elements, model identity, and counterexample artifact.
